description: Read the connection status and identity of the current ReSync network agent.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the network status check.

outputs.name: connected
outputs.description: Reports whether the network agent is connected.

outputs.name: network_id
outputs.description: Returns the current network identity.

outputs.name: node_id
outputs.description: Returns the current network node reference.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the network status is read.

description: List network servers filtered by their current presence status.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the network server lookup.

inputs.name: category
inputs.description: Selects all servers, online servers, or offline servers.

outputs.name: servers
outputs.description: Returns matching network node references sorted by node ID.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: Returns the number of matching servers.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the server lookup failed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when matching servers are available.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the network server lookup fails.

description: Read presence and performance details for one network server.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the server health lookup.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: Selects the network server to inspect.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Reports whether the requested server is present in the current snapshot.

outputs.name: server
outputs.description: Returns the observed server reference.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Returns the server presence status.

outputs.name: players
outputs.description: Returns the number of players observed on the server.

outputs.name: capacity
outputs.description: Returns the observed player capacity.

outputs.name: tps
outputs.description: Returns the observed ticks per second, or -1 when unavailable.

outputs.name: mspt
outputs.description: Returns the observed milliseconds per tick, or -1 when unavailable.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the server health lookup failed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the server health is read.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the server health lookup fails.

description: Read one typed variable from a network scope.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the network variable lookup.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Selects the network variable scope.

inputs.name: scope_id
inputs.description: Identifies the selected realm, group, server, or player scope.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Identifies the variable to read.

outputs.name: exists
outputs.description: Reports whether the variable exists.

outputs.name: variable
outputs.description: Returns the stored network variable metadata.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the decoded variable value.

outputs.name: type
outputs.description: Returns the stored variable type.

outputs.name: revision
outputs.description: Returns the current variable revision.

outputs.name: expires_at
outputs.description: Returns the expiration timestamp in milliseconds, or zero when it does not expire.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the lookup completed.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the lookup failed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the lookup completes successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the lookup fails.

description: Store a typed value in a network scope with an optional time-to-live.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the network variable write.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Selects the network variable scope.

inputs.name: scope_id
inputs.description: Identifies the selected realm, group, server, or player scope.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Identifies the variable to write.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Selects how the value is encoded and decoded.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Provides the value to store.

inputs.name: ttl_seconds
inputs.description: Sets the lifetime in seconds. Zero keeps the variable until it is replaced or removed.

outputs.name: variable
outputs.description: Returns the stored variable metadata.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the decoded value that was stored.

outputs.name: type
outputs.description: Returns the stored variable type.

outputs.name: revision
outputs.description: Returns the new variable revision.

outputs.name: expires_at
outputs.description: Returns the expiration timestamp in milliseconds, or zero when it does not expire.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the variable was stored.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the variable was not stored.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the variable is stored.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the variable cannot be stored.

description: Store a typed network variable only when its current revision matches the expected revision.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the compare-and-set operation.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Selects the network variable scope.

inputs.name: scope_id
inputs.description: Identifies the selected realm, group, server, or player scope.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Identifies the variable to compare and write.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Selects how the new value is encoded.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Provides the value to store when the revision matches.

inputs.name: expected_revision
inputs.description: Sets the revision that must still be current for the write to succeed.

inputs.name: ttl_seconds
inputs.description: Sets the lifetime in seconds. Zero keeps the variable until it is replaced or removed.

outputs.name: variable
outputs.description: Returns the stored variable metadata when the revision matched.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Returns the decoded value that was stored.

outputs.name: type
outputs.description: Returns the stored variable type.

outputs.name: revision
outputs.description: Returns the new variable revision.

outputs.name: expires_at
outputs.description: Returns the expiration timestamp in milliseconds, or zero when it does not expire.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the revision matched and the variable was stored.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the compare-and-set operation failed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the variable is stored.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the revision does not match or the operation fails.

description: Publish a typed event payload to the network with a bounded expiration time.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts publishing the network event.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Sets a stable event identity. Blank input generates a new UUID.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.description: Selects the network event channel.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.description: Sets the event subject used by subscribers.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Provides the value encoded into the event payload.

inputs.name: ttl_seconds
inputs.description: Sets event lifetime in seconds. Values are clamped from 1 second through 7 days.

outputs.name: event_id
outputs.description: Returns the published event identity.

outputs.name: created_at
outputs.description: Returns the event creation timestamp in milliseconds.

outputs.name: expires_at
outputs.description: Returns the event expiration timestamp in milliseconds.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the event was published.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the event was not published.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the event is published.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the event cannot be published.

description: Broadcast a text message through the connected network agent.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts broadcasting the message.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: Provides the message sent to connected network servers.

outputs.name: sent
outputs.description: Reports whether the network agent accepted the message.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the broadcast completed.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the message was not broadcast.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the message is broadcast.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the broadcast fails.

description: Execute a command through the connected network proxy.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the proxy command.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: Provides the command sent to the network proxy.

outputs.name: executed
outputs.description: Reports whether the proxy accepted the command.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the proxy command completed.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the proxy command failed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the proxy command completes.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the proxy command fails.

description: Change the presence mode of a network server.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts changing the server mode.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: Selects the network server to update.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Selects the new server mode.

outputs.name: applied
outputs.description: Reports whether the new mode was accepted.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the server mode changed.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the server mode was not changed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the server mode changes.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the server mode change fails.

description: Route a player through the network to a selected server.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts routing the player.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player to route. The event player is used when no value is connected.

inputs.name: server
inputs.description: Provides the destination server route.

outputs.name: transferred
outputs.description: Reports whether the player transfer succeeded.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Returns the transfer status.

outputs.name: server
outputs.description: Returns the resolved destination route.

outputs.name: transfer_result
outputs.description: Returns structured route outcome details.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the route operation succeeded.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the player was not transferred.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the route succeeds.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the route fails.

description: Fence a player transfer, wait for the target server, and route the player.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts the player handoff.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player to hand off. The event player is used when no value is connected.

inputs.name: target_node
inputs.description: Selects the network node that must accept the handoff.

inputs.name: server
inputs.description: Provides the destination server route.

inputs.name: timeout_seconds
inputs.description: Sets how long to wait for the target node. The value is clamped from 5 through 120 seconds.

outputs.name: transfer_id
outputs.description: Returns the transfer lease identity.

outputs.name: fence_epoch
outputs.description: Returns the fencing epoch assigned to the handoff.

outputs.name: transferred
outputs.description: Reports whether the player reached the selected route.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Returns the transfer status.

outputs.name: server
outputs.description: Returns the resolved destination route.

outputs.name: transfer_result
outputs.description: Returns structured handoff outcome details.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the handoff succeeded.

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: Reports why the handoff failed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the handoff succeeds.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the handoff fails.

description: Run when a network variable changes.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when a variable changes.

outputs.name: event.network_id
outputs.description: Returns the network identity associated with the variable.

outputs.name: event.scope
outputs.description: Returns the variable scope.

outputs.name: event.scope_id
outputs.description: Returns the variable scope identity.

outputs.name: event.key
outputs.description: Returns the changed variable key.

outputs.name: event.type
outputs.description: Returns the changed variable type.

outputs.name: event.value
outputs.description: Returns the decoded new value.

outputs.name: event.revision
outputs.description: Returns the new variable revision.

outputs.name: event.expires_at
outputs.description: Returns the variable expiration timestamp in milliseconds.

outputs.name: event.origin_node_id
outputs.description: Returns the node that originated the change.

description: Run when a published network event is received.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when an event arrives.

outputs.name: event.event_id
outputs.description: Returns the received event identity.

outputs.name: event.network_id
outputs.description: Returns the event network identity.

outputs.name: event.channel
outputs.description: Returns the event channel.

outputs.name: event.subject
outputs.description: Returns the event subject.

outputs.name: event.payload

outputs.name: event.data
outputs.description: Returns the decoded event data.

outputs.name: event.origin_node_id
outputs.description: Returns the node that published the event.

outputs.name: event.created_at
outputs.description: Returns the event creation timestamp in milliseconds.

outputs.name: event.expires_at
outputs.description: Returns the event expiration timestamp in milliseconds.

outputs.name: flow

outputs.name: event.network_id

outputs.name: event.node_id

outputs.name: event.status

outputs.name: event.previous_status
outputs.description: Returns the previous server status.

outputs.name: event.health
outputs.description: Returns the new health label.

outputs.name: event.previous_health
outputs.description: Returns the previous health label.

outputs.name: event.players
outputs.description: Returns the observed player count.

outputs.name: event.capacity
outputs.description: Returns the observed player capacity.

outputs.name: event.tps

outputs.name: event.mspt
outputs.description: Returns the observed milliseconds per tick.

outputs.name: event.observed_at

description: Run when a player joins a network server.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when a player joins.

outputs.name: event.network_id
outputs.description: Returns the network identity.

outputs.name: event.player_id
outputs.description: Returns the joined player's identity.

outputs.name: event.player_name
outputs.description: Returns the joined player's name.

outputs.name: event.occurred_at

outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when a player leaves.

outputs.name: event.network_id
outputs.description: Returns the network identity.

outputs.name: event.player_id
outputs.description: Returns the leaving player's identity.

outputs.name: event.player_name
outputs.description: Returns the leaving player's name.

outputs.description: Returns the server route the player left.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when a transfer starts.

outputs.name: event.network_id
outputs.description: Returns the network identity.

outputs.name: event.player_id
outputs.description: Returns the transferring player's identity.

outputs.name: event.player_name
outputs.description: Returns the transferring player's name.

outputs.name: event.source_server
outputs.description: Returns the route the player is leaving.

description: Run when a network player transfer completes successfully.

outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when a transfer completes.

outputs.name: event.network_id

outputs.name: event.player_id
outputs.description: Returns the transferred player's identity.

outputs.description: Returns the transferred player's name.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Starts the connected flow when a transfer fails.

outputs.name: event.network_id
outputs.description: Returns the network identity.

outputs.name: event.player_id
outputs.description: Returns the affected player's identity.

outputs.name: event.player_name
outputs.description: Returns the affected player's name.

outputs.name: event.source_server
outputs.description: Returns the route the player left.

outputs.name: event.target_server

outputs.name: event.failure

outputs.name: event.occurred_at
